categoryName: Stationery & school supplies — notebooks, pens, pencils, geometry, art & craft, files, calculators, exam boards
method: name-match across all product groups (ARY's category tree is unreliable for this question); terms from the researcher's brand examples plus distinctive nouns, generic retail words dropped; a line counts as covered only above Rs 5,000 of 12-month sales
